AMZN.rationale: Amazon presents a solid fundamental case with strong trajectory. Q3 2025 showed $180.2B revenue (+7.4% QoQ) and EPS of $1.95 (+16.1% QoQ), with accelerating growth across quarters. AWS is the profit engine, generating ~57% of operating income on ~18% of revenue, and reaccelerated to 20%+ growth. The advertising business is a high-margin growth driver at ~$70B annualized. Balance sheet is healthy with $369.6B equity, $55.1B debt, and a debt-to-equity of just 0.149. ROE of 20.7% and net margin of 11.1% are solid for a company of this scale. On valuation, the P/E of 35.0 sits in the middle of its 12-month range (28.2-39.0), roughly in line with its own history — not cheap, not expensive. The P/B of 7.25 is also mid-range (5.8-8.3).
